# FMOD for the Linux and web players, which have no FMOD drop: the API the
# engine calls, mixed in software and played through SDL audio (Web Audio in
# the browser). fmod_stubs.cpp is generated by generate.py.
add_library(fmod_sdl STATIC fmod_sdl.cpp fmod_stubs.cpp Decoder.cpp Decoder.h)
# The single-file decoders are third-party C written for C99 compilers.
set_source_files_properties(Decoder.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-w")
